notes.title: «Warehouse» map Concept
notes.content:
[h3]Hey [b]freelancers![/b][/h3][p]We’re finally ready to unveil our latest experiment — the “[b]Warehouse[/b]” map. We're putting a lot of effort into making maps and gamemodes that feel fresh, dynamic, and genuinely fun to play.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45614182/ebf3edf70d2fc99abea5fea0a1e6381ad46cbf78.png"][/img][/p][p]This one's set in an abandoned distribution center on the outskirts of a megacity, where rusting beams clash with sleek, mirror-like racing lanes. Every route and every prop is carefully designed to balance fast-paced action with immersive atmosphere.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45614182/c975755d4c39be9bce5f0ecce872cb6c5adf8fb7.png"][/img][/p][p]No humans here — just hangars turned into arenas for high-octane battles. Expect graffiti, forgotten cargo, derelict structures, and scattered debris across this gritty new playground.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45614182/d17a999f1d96ba843aa5a0af3fc792e725449859.png"][/img][/p][p]What do you think of the “[b]Warehouse[/b]” concept?
What maps from other games stuck with you — and why?
We’d love to hear your thoughts![/p][p]With love,
[b]TahomoGames[/b] dev team[/p]

notes.content:
[p]This is the main event for all fans of high-speed virtual racing — Racing Fest will start today.[/p][p]Our game, [b]Glide BTL[/b], is taking part in the festival, giving you the chance to take a peek into the [b]future of racing[/b].[/p][p]On our Steam page, you'll find:
• early project details
• screenshots and action-packed trailers
• a “Follow” button so you don’t miss the release and can be among the first pilots[/p][p]If you haven’t added Glide BTL to your wishlist yet — now’s the perfect time to do it![/p][p]And since we’re celebrating racing — tell us: do you have any favorite racing games?
Maybe some childhood classics that still make you smile? What made them special to you?
We’d love to hear your stories :)[/p][p]Thanks for sticking with us — see you at the starting line![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45614182/56b2d91334d7ef75824a2612b02504139bb1d924.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Exploring the World of Glide BTL: Our Unique Maps
notes.content:
[h3][b]Suburb[/b] [/h3][p]Discover a map full of contrast and detail. [i]Suburb[/i] blends overgrown parks where nature reclaims space, an abandoned mansion echoing past luxury, and a sleek, high-tech fuel station cutting through the decay.
This is more than just a battleground — it's a living, breathing corner of the Glide BTL world.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45614182/2d4601e0c3c9687ac2e8d1fcf6e9f102913c49c7.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Factory[/b] [/h3][p]This crumbling industrial giant once roared with machines — now it whispers danger. Twisted metal, broken conveyors, and flickering systems await those brave enough to enter.
Some circuits still run, some machines still move. But none will forgive hesitation.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45614182/3ab1fc512702ae6f39c4bab213537348e8cd2e36.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Swamp[/b] [/h3][p]Toxic runoff, twisted roots, and corporate ruin. [i]Swamp[/i] is where nature and pollution collide.
Though officially under corporate control, freelancers have carved paths through the muck — using the zone for high-risk operations and deadly ambushes.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45614182/8f98736f1718d1a7f323be67a0c5ddd78a9fea10.png"][/img][/p][p]Let us know which map speaks to you the most — or which one you'd risk trying on first.[/p]

notes.title: Your Tactical Toolkit: Combat Modules in Action
notes.content:
[p][b]Freelancers, report in.[/b]
Let’s talk modules.[/p][p]In [i]Control[/i] and [i]Capture[/i] modes, your Glide enters the arena clean — no combat systems, no tricks. You pick up and activate modules on the fly. The right choice, at the right moment, changes everything.[/p][p]Here’s what’s currently in your arsenal:[/p][p][b]Combat Module[/b] – Delivers heavy damage. Knock an enemy out of the match and send them to repairs.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45614182/9d1ca540bf4e8092ecc87ecf6fe26d08412afcbb.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]Time Gun Module[/b] – Disrupts enemy processing, slowing down perception and reaction time. Use it to strike or escape.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45614182/6a7e94c85bdcb6bcb46a0a75758e1da2491b9156.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]EMP Module[/b] – Shuts down control systems completely, leaving the target motionless and exposed.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45614182/a381b7dbfb32b3d8d8720d8fc0aab4d8898c8b1d.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]Shield Module[/b] – Generates a short-lived energy barrier around your Glide. It can block hostile abilities and even protect you from environmental traps.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45614182/bec7eebd219fe37d7a5f88fbc4ae1772854bf623.gif"][/img][/p][p]Each module is temporary. Reactivation or replacement is essential — but timing is everything.[/p][p]You’ll see them in action in the clips below. Which one’s your style?[/p]

notes.title: Wow! Is this... GLIDEs??
notes.content: [h1]Hi everyone![/h1][p]We are pleased to share a series of GIFs and models that reveal the character and visual personality of some of our glides. Each of them was created with attention to detail — not only for the sake of beauty, but also to convey the unique sensations of flight, emphasize the style and enhance gameplay features.[/p][p][b]Zero Formula[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45614182/cf27e3d62f4e3e134bdab86db3dc5d214c2a633e.gif"][/img][/p][p]First glide - aggression, speed and energy.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45614182/79465b1c0b1d36fcf2b106343db0a7c162303807.png"][/img][/p][p]Its hull has powerful turbines, from which bright fire jets escape, leaving only a bright trail behind them. Fast and charged, ZeroFormula will give you the spirit of a real race and instant acceleration. This guide is designed for those who like to take every turn to the limit of their abilities.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Goliaf[/b] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45614182/92364e3819486b3aa660dea7e713b5deef4ea9a6.gif"][/img][/p][p]The new generation glide from Reswit Corporation - massive, aesthetic and challenging.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45614182/0c88d3c06022eacadc88c3f4cefb6b92a7496e89.jpg"][/img] [/p][p]Six cylindrical turbines, three on each side, resemble the paws of a mechanical predator, ready for rapid maneuver. This design gives Goliaf a special grace and control in the air. The green light accents emphasize the feeling of energy circulating inside.  This glide sets a new standard in engineering — reliable and memorable. It is designed for those who are used to dominating not at the expense of speed, but at the expense of maneuverability.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Suwan[/b] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45614182/4449fbf748966ffc2aae8d500646d6cdfc9f7158.gif"][/img][/p][p]Finally, meet Glide Suwan, the epitome of futurism and biomechanics.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45614182/9fbd623b01b301c9717730993dea3924da7f0374.png"][/img][/p][p]Its black hull with metallic accents is inspired by the anatomy of a bat: graceful curves, webbed wings and a strict, streamlined silhouette. Four engines provide excellent aerodynamics and impressive acceleration. This guide is designed for those who prefer nighttime elegance and speed.[/p][p]We want our glides to become unique in their every move. Share your impressions — which of these glides would you choose first?[/p][p]Leave your ideas, share your thoughts — it is important for us to know which of the glides is closer to you![/p][p]Love, [/p][p]TahomoGames team💙[/p]

notes.title: About Glide types
notes.content: [h3]Greetings, future racing stars![/h3][p]Today, we’d like to tell you about the three types of glides you’ll be choosing from.[/p][p]A [i]glide[/i] is a high-speed unmanned aerial vehicle. In a world of advanced technology, every detail matters — and the choice of glide has a significant impact on your gameplay experience.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45614182/d6ab0e67caa96f1449a98354adc5173590476820.jpg"][/img]Each class has its own unique traits:[/p][h3][b]Legacy: Echo of the Past[/b][/h3][p]Glides of this class are a time-tested choice that embody minimalism and reliability. Their simple design offers intuitive controls and stable flight, making them a great option for beginners.  [/p][h3][b]Wing: Flight of dreams[/b][/h3][p]The Wing class is made for those who value freedom and agility. With their smooth and precise turns, these glides offer a graceful yet dynamic flying experience.  [/p][h3][b]Turbo: Speed and power[/b][/h3][p]Turbo glides are built for intense challenges and speed enthusiasts. Equipped with turbines, they deliver powerful thrust and can reach impressive speeds. They require experienced handling, but those who dare will be rewarded with an adrenaline rush and unforgettable moments.. [/p][p]Which class would you choose? Let us know in the comments![/p][p] With love, [/p][p][b]TahomoGames team[/b] 💙[/p]

notes.title: About game modes
notes.content: [h3][b]Hi everyone! [/b][/h3][p][/p][p]We’re back with more insights into the world of [b]Glide BTL[/b] — and today, we’re excited to share the core game modes that will define your experience. Each one offers a unique style of gameplay, from lightning-fast races to intense team-based battles.[/p][previewyoutube="Ul-lSgcu_mM;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3][b]Ring race[/b][/h3][p]A classic mode packed with tension at every turn. It’s not just about crossing the finish line first — you’ll need to hold your position through multiple laps. Sharp corners and unpredictable hazards will keep you on edge from start to finish.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45614182/593377836436f75d7fabfb678bf0b251a8515387.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Control[/b][/h3][p]A tactical team mode where strategy wins. Capture and hold key zones across the map to score points. Coordination, flexibility, and teamwork are essential to victory.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45614182/67d578330958e2d194519c7111d0fcc64212c0ee.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Sprint  [/b][/h3][p]A high-speed dash through intricate tracks — only one can finish first. From glider choice to every turn you take, decisions matter. It’s a test of reflexes and cold-blooded focus.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45614182/fbaffbdbfc6915782fe9b8ce095d837408529abc.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Flag capture [/b][/h3][p]A thrilling showdown where you’ll hunt down enemy flags scattered across the map. Steal them, dodge defenders, and bring them home. Success comes only through tight team play — stay sharp![/p][p][/p][p]We’re designing each mode so that every player can find their own rhythm — whether you prefer time trials or heated multiplayer matches.[/p][p]Stay tuned — there’s so much more to come.[/p][p][/p][p]With love,[/p][p][b]TahomoGames[/b] team 💙[/p]

notes.title: Welcome to the Glide BTL Community!
notes.content:
[h2]Hi everyone![/h2]

Starting today, we’re officially launching our Steam community page — this will be the place for all updates, behind-the-scenes looks, and exclusive content related to the world of Glide BTL.

Our goal is to make this not just an informative way to tell about our game, but a lively one — full of discussions, concepts, and of course, memes.

[previewyoutube=zBcQnqWkP-g;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Glide BTL [/b]is a fast-paced action game set in a neon cyberpunk universe, where you pilot a glide — a nimble unmanned craft capable of overcoming any obstacle. Expect perilous tracks, the vibrant lights of sprawling megacities, and a true sense of speed and freedom.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45614182/01f1ec8fab63107eb3cb1871e048eed455c0ff05.jpg[/img]

[b] We are TahomoGames[/b] — a team brought together by a shared passion for creating what we love. Glide BTL is our debut project, and we’ve poured our hearts into it to ensure every second of flight delivers excitement and adrenaline.

So stick around — there’s plenty more to come.

All the best,
[b]TahomoGames[/b] <3
